column1: # Bodies still to transcribe: recovered VA, the arm that installs it, and how many
# absolute operands it reads (each is a published slot the arm must set before it
# installs). Measured with tools/verify_bodies.py and the IDA database.
# EmissiveLerpFix semantics (settled from the IDB, kept here so it is not
# re-derived): the installer writes the ADDRESS match-16 into 0x10159CC4 and
# match-12 into 0x10159CC8. The shim reads 0x10159CC4 as float bits (absolute
# operand, no dereference) and jumps through 0x10159CC8. The multiply is inert -
# the helper zeroes the saved EDX that the shim reloads - so the pair's effect is
